create_denoising_dataset: create a DenoisingDataset instance wrapping a TokenBlockDataset with BART-style noise parameters
add_whole_word_mask: apply whole word masking to source tokens using a configurable mask ratio and span distribution
add_insertion_noise: add insertion noise tokens to a token sequence at a specified probability rate
permute_sentences: permute sentence order in a token sequence by detecting full stops and shuffling spans
collate_samples: collate a list of sample dicts into a padded mini-batch tensor with source and target
